key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr delivered the lowest measured wear rate and best corrosion resistance, while HVOF achieved the highest hardness.
engineering_relevance: HVAF is a promising coating route for 304 stainless steel components requiring combined wear and corrosion protection.
method: Deposit WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation, HVOF and HVAF spraying.
Compare microstructure, Vickers hardness, friction, wear and corrosion behavior.
Examine wear tracks to identify abrasive and fatigue wear mechanisms.
evidence_signal: HVAF reduced volume wear rate from (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ to (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m) versus uncoated steel and showed the lowest corrosion current density, 1.75±0.02 µA/cm².
watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or corrosion medium, limiting direct transfer of the rankings to service environments.
paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
